t: Robust DEWALT rafter square constructed with an extra-thick aluminum body for heavy duty use. The durable speed square is an essential measuring tool for accurate carpentry, roofing, and construction tasks and also serves effectively as a reliable saw guide. A large base ensures a firm grip on materials, providing stability during use. Features stamped-in contrasting colour graduations for enhanced readability and a 90° angle scale with 1° graduations, enabling precise, straightforward measurements and marking out of angles. Specialised scales for common jack rafters, hip, and valley rafters increase versatility for complex roof framing jobs. The integrated pivot point also simplifies accurate angle layout.
b: Integrated Pivot Point Simplifies Angle Marking & Layout
Large Base Ensures Firm Grip On Workpiece Materials
